title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Memory
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Memory. Details with respect to properties and capabilities of RAM. Subclass of Device per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Device model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Memory'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

memorySize.description: Relationship. Memory size of the RAM. Links to a MemorySize entity.

memoryClass.description: Property. DRAM technology name defined by JEDEC. Controlled-vocabulary value (MemoryClasses), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

memoryRank.description: Property. Rank defines the number of memory chip banks and buffering used to access them. Controlled-vocabulary value (MemoryRanks), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

eccEnabled.description: Property. Error connection code (ECC) allows detecting and correcting bit errors in data.

hardwareEncryption.description: Property. If true, encryption of memory at the hardware level is enabled.
